works.title: Mycelial Delirium
works.story: A red cap with white spots sits over a black-and-white face, blue eyes, and a red tongue.
works.alt: An upright original painting of a red-capped mushroom with white spots, blue eyes, and a red tongue on a blue ground.

works.title: Chromatic Rupture
works.story: Purple, pink, and red forms cross a horizontal canvas, with a bright pink ring near the lower edge.
works.alt: A horizontal original painting of purple, pink, and red abstract forms, with a bright pink ring near the bottom.

works.title: The Unquiet Interior
works.story: A red cap and a gold-rimmed eye sit in a blue field, with smaller red forms at the sides.
works.alt: An upright original painting with a red cap, a gold-rimmed eye, and smaller red forms on a blue ground.

works.title: Fragments of the Unconscious
works.story: A wide painted wood panel with a central face, gold marks, and a row of teeth.
works.alt: A wide painted wood panel with a central face, gold marks, and a row of teeth.

works.title: The Anatomy of Unreason
works.story: A sculptural mixed-media painting with a doll’s head on the left and a painted face on the right.
works.alt: A sculptural mixed-media painting with a doll’s head on the left and a painted face on the right. Private collection, not for sale.
